hpe_js_dom_install.brief: 注册 `document` 宿主对象及其虚表 / Register the `document` host object and its vtables

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.document: 文档根 DOM 节点 / The document root DOM node

hpe_js_dom_install.note: 同时注册元素与样式表的属性拦截虚表 / Also registers the element and stylesheet property-access vtables

hpe_js_dom_node_value.brief: 把 DOM 节点包装成脚本可见的宿主值 / Wrap a DOM node in the host value scripts see

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.node: 待包装的 DOM 节点 / The DOM node to wrap

hpe_js_dom_node_value.return: 携带元素或片段虚表的宿主值 / The host value carrying the element or fragment vtable
hpe_js_dom_node_value.note: MutationObserver 桥用它把完全可用的节点作为记录 `target` 交回脚本 / The MutationObserver bridge uses it to hand a fully usable node back as a record's `target`

hpe_js_dom_dispatch.brief: 向目标节点及其祖先派发事件（冒泡）/ Dispatch an event to a target node and its ancestors with bubbling

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.target: 事件目标节点 / The event target node
params.type: 事件类型名（如 `click`）/ The event type name, such as `click`
params.clientX: 客户端 X 坐标 / Client X coordinate
params.clientY: 客户端 Y 坐标 / Client Y coordinate

hpe_js_dom_dispatch.return: 有处理函数被调用返回 1 / 1 when any handler was invoked
hpe_js_dom_dispatch.note: 传给处理函数的事件对象为 `{ type, clientX, clientY, target, currentTarget, preventDefault }` / Handlers receive an event object shaped like `{ type, clientX, clientY, target, currentTarget, preventDefault }`
